steps.content: You ruin the chessboard because you can't win the game? What a philistine.
Come out. You ruined a good game of chess.
The light gradually brightens, and the first thing you see is a shrunken chessboard. The pieces on the chessboard are broken from smashing into each other, much like the board you just fought on.
As the area becomes brighter, you see a giant "tree" formed by a chessboard. Eirene sits at the foot of the "tree," gazing at you from across the chessboard.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: A few days ago, you declined my invitation. Now, you show up uninvited and trespass onto my chessboard.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: What do you want, Chief of Minos?
